digest.component_or_area: CI workflow and pytest test selection
propositions: Nineteen repository-policy assertions that inspect only immutable repository text/AST are redundantly executed across all four default-suite matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13) despite their OS/Python-invariant contract
The shared workflow applies identical default marker expression to all platform/version cells, causing static policy nodes to run four times when they need run only once on Ubuntu 3.13
A new pytest marker 'repo_policy' must be registered and applied at function level to exactly the 19 inventoried nodes; all unmarked tests in mixed modules retain their original selection
The Ubuntu 3.13 default process keeps the repo_policy nodes unfiltered; the other three default cells append 'and not repo_policy' to suppress redundant execution; no new CI job or runner is added
Workflow parity tests must prove marked/non-marked partitioning, confirm all four matrix cells remain, verify exactly two pytest sessions exist, and confirm integration routing is unchanged
